_notes: UQM 0.8.0's KillLanderCrewSeq (lander.c), as GenerateSol_pickupEnergy calls it when a lander runs into Fwiffo on Pluto (FWIFFO_FRAGS 8, ONE_SECOND / 20 = 42 ticks apart), recorded by running it on a lander with so many crew and LANDER_SHIELDS set, drawing and sound stubbed and a clock that each sleep moves on (tools/extract/golden/lander.c's killcrew mode). Code only, no content.

runs: crew (crew_left before), shields (LANDER_SHIELDS: 15 every shield), count and period (its arguments, the period in ticks of ONE_SECOND 840), lived (its result: crew left), crew_left and damage_index after it, deaths (each SleepThreadUntil it called, after a DeltaLanderCrew (-1, LANDER_INJURED): [the clock then, crew_left then, the tick it sleeps to]) and seed_same (TFB_Random's seed unchanged: LANDER_INJURED's shield bit lies past the four shields, so no shield is asked about and nothing is drawn).
